headline: Threat to Saudi Arabia's energy hub and a difficult problem for President Trump
summary: Threats aimed at Saudi Arabia's critical energy facilities are raising concerns about a new shock to the global oil market. The article also describes this as a difficult problem for President Trump.
why: Saudi Arabia is the world's largest crude oil exporter and home to Saudi Aramco, so threats to its energy infrastructure can quickly affect global crude prices and supply expectations.
why_moved: The article reports threats to Saudi energy facilities and concerns about a new shock to the global oil market. Such supply-risk fears typically push crude prices higher.
